messages:
anya: Quick thought: add a "threshold onboarding" step in the SLO editor that proposes defaults based on recent telemetry + per-route quotas. Might cut down on noisy, hand-crafted thresholds.

mike: Yeah. Backend could compute 30d p50/p95 + error rate and return recommendations. Example payload: `suggested: {latency_p95: p95 * 1.2, error_rate: max(p99, 0.01)}`

lee: We need to guard for low-sample streams. If sample_count < 1000 or variance high, show low-confidence and don't auto-apply.

jordan: UX: show two buttons — "Apply suggested" and "Create strict alert". If user applies suggestion, create a canary rule (5% traffic for 1h) by default. Don't let teams accidentally flip on full-notify. :warning:

sofia: Telemetry idea: inline sparkline + tiny stats: `samples: 12k | uniques: 42 | lookback: 30d`. Also display a confidence badge with tooltip explaining why it's green/yellow/red.

anya: Good. Also capture the metric ingest ids used to compute the suggestion (e.g., `ingest: metrics-v2-2026-03`) so SRE/support can trace recommendations.

mike: API design: `POST /api/v1/suggestions/thresholds` with body `{route_id, lookback, mode: "suggest"}` -> response `{suggested_values, confidence, sample_stats, rationale, sources}`. Make it idempotent and cacheable by route+lookback.

lee: Suggestion job should be async and cached (ttl 24h). Hit to metrics backend for every UI open would be too heavy. Also rate-limit per-tenant to avoid abuse.

jordan: Rollout plan: feature-gate behind console beta flag. Start with a handful of PLG orgs, enable notify-preview (sends test alert to a single channel) so teams can validate noise before enabling full notifications.

sofia: Add a "preview channel" checkbox in the editor: creates a notify-preview that fires once for the canary window. Helps catch misfires.

anya: Policy composition notes: final evaluation order must be explicit in UI: suggested -> tenant overrides -> global suppressors -> routing quotas. Show a small expandable trace of which rule produced the effective threshold.

mike: Security/observability: record an audit event when suggestions are applied/overridden. Also show the cached suggestion TTL in the UI.

lee: Edge case: bursty tenants will have misleading p95. Consider using peak-aware heuristics or percentile-of-median across daily windows. We'll document in the RFC.

jordan: Ops concern: if suggestions are wrong and everyone applies them, paging could spike. Hence the canary + preview channel + beta gate. Also consider automatic rollback if alert noise increases after enabling.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled staging deploy for `suggestions-worker` at 16:00 UTC. /deploys/4821

sofia: I'll drop a quick mock in FigJam with the editor flow and the preview checkbox, ping @anya for review.

mike: I'll scaffold the API and a lightweight worker to compute cached suggestions.

anya: Plan recap: 1) RFC + API proto 2) suggestions-worker (async cached) 3) editor UI + preview channel 4) beta rollout to PLG orgs + canary rules. I'll draft RFC and share by EOD. Thanks everyone!
